title: De-duplicate hand-typed matrix literals from write_payloads.json PAYLOADS in firestore_rules.test.mjs (stage_definitions.track_id, study_day_configs.day_type)
why: The file's own comment at line 459-461 documents a real incident: 'A stale fixture carrying track_type made this rules test red on dev... invisible because test-rules isn't wired into make ci.' That incident is exactly this pattern repeating: the hand-typed Path-13 `validStage` literal encodes `track_id` as a STRING ('t1') while the codec-derived PAYLOADS.stage_definitions fixture (the file's own stated 'single source of truth') encodes it as a NUMBER (1); similarly Path-22's `validConfig.day_type` is 'learning' while PAYLOADS.study_day_configs.day_type (used by PHASE E, line 844) is 'study'. Neither copy is cross-checked against the other. Today neither divergence trips a rule (hasOnly only checks key names, not value types), so nothing is currently broken — this is a latent maintenance trap that reproduces the file's own documented failure mode, not a live bug.
recommendation: Derive the Path-13/Path-22 matrix literals from PAYLOADS (spread + override, as PHASE D/E already do) instead of hand-typing a second copy, or add an explicit comment cross-referencing the fixture so a schema change prompts updating both.
acceptance_criteria: stage_definitions and study_day_configs matrix-test literals are sourced from PAYLOADS or explicitly comment-linked to it so one edit updates both
